lead: Questions over President Tinubu's whereabouts grew, with the ADC and Peter Obi demanding answers six days after his announced leave ended, as reports said he was expected home on Tuesday. A car rammed a gas shop in Kubwa, Abuja, causing an explosion and fire, and gunmen killed five miners in Barkin Ladi. Resident doctors gave the government 14 days to avert a strike, Ekiti's governor dissolved all boards and political appointments, and Nollywood film Black Market set a Guinness record for a screening attended by 51,000 people.

items.h: ADC and Obi demand to know where Tinubu is
items.s: The ADC campaign asked the Presidency to explain the President's prolonged stay abroad six days after his announced leave ended, and Peter Obi asked the same question. Reports said Tinubu's return, after four weeks in London and Paris, is now expected on Tuesday.

items.h: Explosion as car rams gas shop in Kubwa
items.s: An early morning blast at Liberty Junction on Sunday injured the driver and started a fire that spread to nearby shops and a police vehicle.

items.h: Gunmen kill five miners in Barkin Ladi
items.s: Attackers ambushed miners at Marit village at about 1pm on Saturday; two others were injured before troops and hunters drove them off.

items.h: Resident doctors give FG 14 days to avert strike
items.s: The National Association of Resident Doctors threatened a nationwide strike if its demands are not met.

items.h: Ekiti governor dissolves boards and sacks political appointees
items.s: Governor Biodun Oyebanji dissolved every state board, commission and agency council and ended the appointments of all his political aides with immediate effect.

items.h: Nollywood's Black Market sets Guinness screening record
items.s: 51,000 people watched the film at Tafawa Balewa Square, Lagos, the largest attendance at a single-venue screening.

items.h: Public debt up 90.9% since May 2023
items.s: Debt rose from N87.38 trillion to N166.79 trillion, with the Federal Government accounting for N152.77 trillion.

items.h: Atiku asks Tinubu to raise minimum wage
items.s: The ADC candidate said workers need a pay rise.

items.h: Shettima says Africa's exclusion undermines UN legitimacy
items.s: The Vice President restated Nigeria's call for permanent African Security Council seats.

items.h: APC passes vote of confidence in Tinubu and Shettima
items.s: Party chairman Nentawe Yilwatda said the APC is ready for 2027.

items.h: Aondoakaa urges calm after campaign materials burnt in Benue
items.s: The PDP governorship candidate told supporters not to retaliate.

items.h: Kano restricts durbar and horse riding
items.s: The government cited security concerns and the risk of clashes.

items.h: Correctional service says two died in Kano cholera outbreak
items.s: It disputed Amnesty International's figure of six.

items.h: Adamawa approves N169.1bn supplementary budget
items.s: The council approved projects in roads, health, power and education.

items.h: Kano best-performing state in NECO for second year
items.s: 74,413 Kano candidates obtained five credits including English and maths, ahead of Lagos and Oyo.

items.h: FG approves upgrade of four eastern ports
items.s: Onne, Rivers, Delta and Calabar ports will be modernised.

items.h: Air Peace blames Jet A1 shortage for disruptions
items.s: The airline also cited a restriction at Maiduguri airport.

items.h: Ex-lawmaker petitions Trump over 2006 Atiku probe
items.s: Ehiozuwa Agbonayinma asked for a review of the US investigation.

items.h: Pantami supporters say Supreme Court ruling does not affect him
items.s: They insisted he can still contest the Gombe PDP primary.

items.h: Zulum declares Borno APC territory
items.s: He urged losing aspirants to rally behind the party.

items.h: 200 APC and LP members join PDP in Ebonyi
items.s: The party said it is gaining ground.

items.h: Naval chief tells personnel to stay apolitical
items.s: Vice Admiral Idi Abbas warned ahead of 2027.

items.h: Troops kill terrorist and rescue six in Sokoto and Zamfara
items.s: An AK-47 and a motorcycle were recovered.

items.h: NDLEA signs anti-drug pact with UAE
items.s: The MoU with the National Drug Enforcement Authority deepens cooperation.

items.h: Man arrested over killing linked to N500 gift
items.s: Police said a dispute over the money led to a fatal stabbing.

items.h: Flamingos win WAFU B U17 Girls Cup
items.s: Nigeria beat Togo 4-0 and won all five matches.

items.h: Super Eagles fly to Bissau for Tuesday qualifier
items.s: The team left Uyo after beating Madagascar.

items.h: 10th AFRIMA set for Lagos in May 2027
items.s: The awards run from 18 to 23 May.

items.h: Trump rejects Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz
items.s: US pressure is hitting Iranian banks and airlines.
